description: Non-engineering background making an IC transition. Strong product and business judgment signals but no direct software engineering work experience on the résumé.

inputs.[PASTE JOB DESCRIPTION]: Design, develop, and deploy scalable software systems with high reliability and low latency. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive technical decision-making.

experience.title: Product Manager at Acme Corp
bulletPoints: - Developed and executed product roadmaps that resulted in 25% increase in revenue.
- Led cross-functional teams to launch new features, resulting in 95% customer satisfaction ratings.
- Collaborated with engineering team to improve product reliability by 30%
- Analyzed market trends and competitor analysis to inform product decisions

experience.title: Operations Manager at DataScale Inc
bulletPoints: - Managed a team of 10 to improve operational efficiency by 20%
- Developed and implemented process improvements that resulted in 15% cost savings.
- Collaborated with executive team to develop strategic plans for company growth

evalCriteria: Should detect a mismatch between the candidate's current role and target role.
Should flag the lack of direct software engineering experience as a potential weakness.
Should rate the candidate's ability to communicate technical concepts as weak or missing.
Should identify areas where the candidate can leverage their product management experience in an IC role.
Should ask evidence recovery questions about how the candidate would handle complex technical discussions.
